description: This Java source file defines the AuditLogController class, which provides REST API endpoints for retrieving audit logs based on various filters such as customer ID, user ID, entity ID, and general logs. It includes methods for handling HTTP GET requests, parsing parameters, and interacting with the audit log service.

classes.name: AuditLogController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for retrieving audit logs filtered by customer, user, entity, or general scope.

methods.name: getAuditLogsByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of audit logs for a specific customer ID, with optional filters.

methods.name: getAuditLogsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of audit logs for a specific user ID, with optional filters.

methods.name: getAuditLogsByEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of audit logs for a specific entity type and ID, with optional filters.

methods.name: getAuditLogs
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all audit logs within the tenant scope, with optional filters.

methods.name: parseActionTypesStr
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of action types into a list of ActionType enums.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time for filtering, defaulting to 1 if null.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time for filtering, defaulting to current system time if null.
